idea.name: Base44 AI app builder
idea.one_liner: A prompt-based app builder for people making apps; free entry and credit usage for larger projects.
idea.customer: People who want to build apps from prompts, including first-time builders.
idea.offer: Generates and updates apps from user prompts; the test used it to build a CRM.
idea.revenue_model: Free to start, with credit usage for larger projects; full pricing is not stated.
